I need to decide whether to bid on Pacific Avenue in this Monopoly auction.

I have $486 and no green monopoly. Pacific Avenue is the only open green property. The current bid is $160. I need to decide if the rent potential justifies the cost.

The $160 bid sits at the top of my comfort zone. I would be rent-dead if I buy it. Completing the green set would cost over $900 in houses alone. I should let the other bidders drain cash instead.

Mortgaging all holdings would cover a $600 Boardwalk rent, but that leaves me cash-poor. A higher bid would drain my remaining funds.

I am checking the trade history to verify p1's holdings. p1 offered Connecticut Avenue and Water Works for Park Place, but those properties may not have belonged to p1 at that time.

The accepted trade shows p1 giving up Park Place for $700 plus Connecticut Avenue and Water Works. Yet the current state lists p4 owning those exact properties. This inconsistency makes it hard to trust the trade history.

Turn 16 shows p4 bought Park Place for $350. The accepted trade description conflicts with current holdings, so the action text is likely wrong. p1 actually owns a dark blue monopoly with $64 cash.

p4 has $1310 and no monopoly. p3 has $1170 and no monopoly. I have $486 and no monopoly. Pacific Avenue is listed at $300. The $160 bid is within my soft ceiling of $150–180.

Bidding $161 would only win if the other bidders drop out. p3 and p4 both have $1170 and $1310 cash, so they can easily outbid me. They likely do not need Pacific to complete any set. Pacific is just a foothold in an unowned group. I am now weighing whether that strategic value justifies the cost.

Mortgaging everything would give me $856 in total liquidity. That barely covers a $600 Boardwalk hit, but after that I would be cripple. A single green is not worth the cash risk.

I will drop out. A $170 bid leaves me with only $316 cash and still no green set. p4 is the biggest threat with $1310, and p3 has $1170 plus Ventnor. Letting them drain each other's cash is the better strategy.

A $161 bid would leave me with only $325 cash and still no green set. I will stay silent and let the other bidders fight it out.
